<style>
/* Single committed look, built only from the ViSTARS brand kit v4:
   Night ground #0B1013, night green #0E3328, and the brand gradient #00FF94 > #00FFE0 > #A59DFF.
   Geist for type, Geist Mono for the small labels. The agency runs this palette loud:
   full-bleed glow, the live dollar trace, counting numbers. The tech company runs it quiet. */
:root{
  --night:#0B1013;
  --night-2:#0F171B;
  --night-3:#151D22;
  --stage:#0E3328;
  --stage-deep:#082019;
  --panel:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --line-g:rgba(0,255,148,.28);
  --text:#F3F7F5;
  --text-2:#A9B6B1;
  --text-3:#8B9893;
  --mint:#00FF94;
  --cyan:#00FFE0;
  --peri:#A59DFF;
  --grad:linear-gradient(100deg,#00FF94 0%,#00FFE0 45%,#A59DFF 100%);
  --f-sans:"Source Sans 3",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --f-mono:"Source Sans 3",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --gutter-l:max(clamp(16px,4vw,40px),env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  --gutter-r:max(clamp(16px,4vw,40px),env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  color-scheme:dark;
}
:root{color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--night);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--f-sans);font-size:18px;line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--night);z-index:60}
h1,h2,h3,p,ul,ol,dl,dd{margin:0;padding:0}
ul,ol{list-style:none}
a{color:inherit}
button,input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:var(--gutter-l);top:-80px;background:var(--text);color:var(--night);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:10px;z-index:100;text-decoration:none}
.skip:focus{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 8px)}
.wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--gutter-l);padding-right:var(--gutter-r)}
.mono{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.02em}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.014em;text-wrap:balance}
h2.big{font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,76px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.016em;font-weight:600}
.lede{color:var(--text-2);font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,20px);line-height:1.5;max-width:34rem}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-2)}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:40px;height:2px;background:var(--mint);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--mint)}
.gt{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}

/* shared effects */
.gridbg{position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.gridbg::before,.gridbg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 25%,#000 10%,transparent 78%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 25%,#000 10%,transparent 78%)}
.gridbg::before{background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.055) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:64px 64px}
.gridbg::after{background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 42%,rgba(0,255,148,.16) 50%,transparent 58%);background-size:260% 100%;animation:sweep 10s linear infinite}
@keyframes sweep{from{background-position:130% 0}to{background-position:-130% 0}}
.orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(100px);pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
.spot{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.spot::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s;background:radial-gradient(420px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%),rgba(0,255,148,.16),transparent 62%)}
.spot:hover::before{opacity:1}

/* buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font-weight:500;font-size:16px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:transform .2s,background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .3s}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn-mint{background:var(--mint);color:#04140D;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(0,255,148,.4)}
.btn-mint:hover{background:#3DFFAE;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(0,255,148,.16),0 0 40px rgba(0,255,148,.35)}
.btn-ghost{border-color:var(--line-g);color:var(--text);background:rgba(0,255,148,.05)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--mint);background:rgba(0,255,148,.1)}
.btn svg{width:16px;height:16px}

/* nav */
.nav-shell{position:sticky;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px);z-index:50;height:0}
/* the menu pill's 12px top margin collapsed through this 0-height bar and pushed the page down, leaving a dark strip */
.nav-shell{margin-bottom:-12px}
.nav{padding-left:var(--gutter-l);padding-right:var(--gutter-r)}
.pill{max-width:1240px;margin:12px auto 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:6px 6px 6px 22px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(11,16,19,.66);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.mark{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px}
.mark img{height:26px;width:auto;display:block}
.links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.links a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 15px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;color:var(--text-2);transition:color .2s,background .2s}
.links a:hover{color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.links a.btn{min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;font-size:15px;color:#04140D;background:var(--mint)}
.links a.btn:hover{color:#04140D;background:#3DFFAE}

/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-top:clamp(120px,15vw,172px)}
.hero .orb.o1{width:60vw;height:60vw;max-width:880px;max-height:880px;left:-10%;top:-12%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,255,148,.55),rgba(14,51,40,.9) 55%,transparent 72%);animation:drift 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.hero .orb.o2{width:46vw;height:46vw;max-width:680px;max-height:680px;right:-12%;top:8%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(165,157,255,.42),transparent 68%);animation:drift 30s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse}
.hero .orb.o3{width:50vw;height:30vw;left:25%;top:42%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(0,255,224,.2),transparent 70%)}
@keyframes drift{from{transform:translate3d(-3%,0,0) scale(1)}to{transform:translate3d(5%,5%,0) scale(1.1)}}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(46px,9.4vw,142px);line-height:.94;letter-spacing:-0.02em;font-weight:700;max-width:12.5ch;margin-top:26px}
.hero h1 .w{display:inline-block;animation:rise .95s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i)*75ms + 120ms)}
.hero h1 .a{color:#E8EFEC}
.hero h1 .g1{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#00FF94,#00FFE0);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero h1 .g2{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#00FFE0,#A59DFF);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);filter:blur(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
.hero-copy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:end;gap:32px 56px;margin-top:clamp(28px,4vw,44px)}
.hero-copy .tag{font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px);letter-spacing:-0.008em;line-height:1.2;font-weight:500}
.hero-copy .sub{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:12px;max-width:34rem;font-size:clamp(16px,1.4vw,19px)}
.cta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}

/* hero visual: buckets and tanks, v2 */
.hv{position:relative;margin-top:clamp(44px,6vw,80px);border-radius:32px;padding:clamp(22px,3.4vw,48px);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06),rgba(255,255,255,.012)),radial-gradient(120% 80% at 0% 0%,rgba(0,255,148,.11),transparent 55%),radial-gradient(90% 70% at 100% 100%,rgba(165,157,255,.13),transparent 60%);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);box-shadow:0 60px 140px -50px rgba(0,255,148,.4),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.hv::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;padding:1px;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,255,148,.7),rgba(255,255,255,.04) 32%,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 66%,rgba(165,157,255,.7));
  -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box exclude,linear-gradient(#000 0 0)}
.hv-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px 32px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hv-q{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,64px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.02em;font-weight:650;max-width:19ch;text-wrap:balance}
.hv-four{display:inline-block;font-size:1.32em;line-height:.8;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.024em;padding-right:.04em}
.hv-sample{margin:0}
.tag-s{display:inline-block;border:1px solid rgba(165,157,255,.6);color:var(--peri);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 14px;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.hv-stage{position:relative;margin-top:clamp(20px,3vw,40px);height:clamp(430px,38vw,500px)}
.hv-stage.hv-compact{height:clamp(350px,50vw,430px)}
.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-pill,.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-t,.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-miss,.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-under{display:none}
.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-adv b,.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-pub b{font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,26px)}
.hv-stage.hv-compact~.hv-legend{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.hv-stage canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.hv-l{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;color:var(--text-2);font-size:13px;line-height:1.3}
.hv-l .k{display:block;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-2);margin-bottom:6px}
.hv-l b{display:block;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-0.016em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hv-adv,.hv-pub{text-align:center;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap}
.hv-adv b{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);color:var(--text)}
.hv-pub b{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);color:var(--mint)}
.hv-under{text-align:center;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-3)}
.hv-under b{display:inline;font-size:18px;color:var(--text);margin-right:6px}
.hv-under.pub b{color:var(--mint)}
.hv-pill{transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;width:min(158px,13.5vw)}
.hv-pill b{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.008em;color:var(--text);line-height:1.15}
.hv-pill i{display:inline-block;margin-top:7px;font-style:normal;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--peri);border:1px solid rgba(165,157,255,.5);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;background:rgba(165,157,255,.07);white-space:nowrap}
.hv-t{transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}
.hv-t b{font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,28px);color:var(--peri)}
.hv-t small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-3);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hv-miss{opacity:0;transition:opacity .8s ease;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.hv-miss.on{opacity:1}
.hv-miss b{font-size:clamp(34px,4.2vw,58px);line-height:.95;color:var(--peri)}
.hv-miss span{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:15px;color:var(--text)}
.hv-miss small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-3)}
.hv-legend{display:none;margin:20px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;gap:12px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--text-2)}
.hv-legend li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.hv-legend i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto}
.hv-legend b{margin-left:auto;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right}
.hv-foot{margin:22px 0 0;max-width:62rem;color:var(--text-3);font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .hv{border-radius:26px}
  .hv-stage.hv-compact{height:360px}
  .hv-stage.hv-compact~.hv-legend{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hv .eyebrow{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;gap:10px}
  .hv .eyebrow::before{width:26px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hv-miss{transition:none}}

/* stats */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0}
.stat{padding:clamp(28px,4vw,52px) clamp(14px,2vw,28px) clamp(28px,4vw,52px) 0;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
.stat+.stat{padding-left:clamp(14px,2vw,28px)}
.stat:last-child{border-right:0}
.stat .n{font-size:clamp(40px,5.1vw,76px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.02em;line-height:.95;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stat p{color:var(--text-2);font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;margin-top:12px;max-width:16rem}
.stat p.n{color:transparent;margin-top:0;max-width:none;font-size:clamp(40px,5.1vw,76px);line-height:.95}

/* sellers */
.sellers{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-block:22px;background:var(--night-2)}
.sellers .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px}
.sellers .lab{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.35}
.sellers .lab b{display:block;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;font-size:15px}
.marquee{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent)}
.track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:scroll 60s linear infinite}
.marquee:hover .track,.marquee:focus-within .track{animation-play-state:paused}
.track ul{display:flex;gap:44px;padding-right:44px}
.track li{white-space:nowrap;font-size:19px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:var(--text-2)}
@keyframes scroll{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

.band{padding-block:clamp(72px,9vw,128px);position:relative}

/* problem */
.problem{overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--night),var(--stage-deep) 60%,var(--night))}
.problem .orb{right:-14%;top:18%;width:60vw;height:60vw;max-width:820px;max-height:820px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,255,148,.34),rgba(14,51,40,.6) 55%,transparent 72%)}
.dollar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.05fr);gap:56px 80px;align-items:center;margin-top:clamp(48px,6vw,88px)}
.never{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(120px,20vw,280px);line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-0.024em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.never small{font-size:.3em;margin-top:.14em;margin-left:.04em;letter-spacing:0;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.never-label{font-size:clamp(18px,1.8vw,22px);color:var(--text-2);margin-top:20px;max-width:24rem}
.seg{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:32px}
.seg button{min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:999px;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;color:var(--text-2);white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.seg button:hover{color:var(--text)}
.seg button[aria-checked="true"]{background:var(--mint);color:#04140D;font-weight:600}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 28px;margin-top:32px;max-width:30rem}
.facts div{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 0 18px}
.facts dt{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-3)}
.facts dd{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-0.016em;font-weight:600;margin-top:2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cells{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);gap:clamp(6px,1.1vw,14px);padding:clamp(18px,2.4vw,32px);border-radius:24px;background:rgba(8,32,25,.55);border:1px solid var(--line-g);box-shadow:0 0 80px -20px rgba(0,255,148,.3) inset}
.cells i{display:block;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);transition:background .5s,box-shadow .5s}
.cells i.on{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#B8FFE0,var(--mint) 55%,var(--cyan));box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,255,148,.6)}
.source{margin-top:48px;color:var(--text-3);font-size:14px;max-width:46rem;line-height:1.55}

/* review */
.route{margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px);max-width:34rem}
.route .cap{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-3)}
.route ol{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);margin-top:22px}
.route ol::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:12.5%;right:12.5%;top:9px;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.route ol::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:12.5%;top:9px;height:2px;width:75%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--mint),var(--cyan));background-size:30% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;animation:pulse 3.2s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.3,1) infinite}
@keyframes pulse{from{background-position:-40% 0}to{background-position:140% 0}}
.route li{position:relative;text-align:center;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.3}
.route li i{display:block;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 12px;background:var(--night);border:2px solid #3A474D;position:relative;z-index:1}
.route li:last-child i{border-color:var(--mint);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(0,255,148,.12),0 0 24px rgba(0,255,148,.6);animation:glowpulse 3.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes glowpulse{0%,60%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,255,148,.08),0 0 10px rgba(0,255,148,.3)}85%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(0,255,148,.16),0 0 30px rgba(0,255,148,.75)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,255,148,.08),0 0 10px rgba(0,255,148,.3)}}
.route li b{display:block;color:var(--text);font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.fee{margin-top:clamp(56px,7vw,96px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px 48px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:clamp(24px,3vw,40px);border-radius:24px;border:1px solid var(--line-g);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(14,51,40,.9),rgba(8,32,25,.7) 60%,rgba(165,157,255,.1))}
.fee p{max-width:44rem;color:var(--text-2);font-size:17px}
.fee p b{color:var(--text);font-weight:500}

/* services */
.svc-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:24px 64px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.svc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,72px)}
.svc li{padding:28px 26px 34px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;background:var(--panel);transition:border-color .3s}
.svc li:hover{border-color:var(--line-g)}
.svc h3{font-size:clamp(21px,2vw,26px);line-height:1.12;position:relative}
.svc p{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:12px;font-size:16px;max-width:24rem;position:relative}

/* work */
.work{background:var(--night-2)}
.scenario{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,72px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:32px 64px;align-items:center;padding:clamp(28px,4.5vw,64px);border-radius:30px;border:1px solid var(--line-g);background:var(--stage)}
.scenario::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:48px 48px;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 50%,#000,transparent 75%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 50%,#000,transparent 75%)}
.scenario::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-12%;top:-40%;width:70%;height:180%;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(circle at 60% 50%,rgba(0,255,148,.45),rgba(0,255,224,.15) 45%,transparent 68%);filter:blur(30px);animation:drift 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.pilltag{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--line-g);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2);background:rgba(8,32,25,.7)}
.scenario h3{font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,44px);line-height:1.05;margin-top:22px;font-weight:600}
.scenario p.d{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:16px;max-width:30rem}
.scenario .num{font-size:clamp(60px,8.2vw,124px);white-space:nowrap;font-weight:700;line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-0.024em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.scenario .cap{color:var(--text);opacity:.86;margin-top:14px;max-width:24rem;font-size:16px}
.engage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 40px;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px)}
.engage article{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 0 12px}
.engage .tg{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--mint)}
.engage h3{font-size:clamp(24px,2.4vw,30px);margin-top:10px}
.engage p{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:8px;font-size:16px}
.engage ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 16px;margin-top:16px;color:var(--text-3);font-size:14px}
.roster{margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,72px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px 56px}
.roster h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--text-3);margin-bottom:12px}
.roster ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 26px}
.roster li{font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);letter-spacing:-0.012em;font-weight:500;color:var(--text)}

/* team */
.team{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 36px;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,72px)}
.team li{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:22px 0 34px}
.team h3{font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,25px);line-height:1.1}
.team p{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:6px;font-size:15px}

/* request */
.request{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;padding-block:clamp(88px,12vw,160px);background:var(--stage-deep)}
.request .orb{left:-12%;bottom:-45%;width:90vw;height:90vw;max-width:1100px;max-height:1100px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,255,148,.5),rgba(14,51,40,.8) 50%,transparent 72%)}
.request .orb.b{left:auto;right:-14%;top:-30%;bottom:auto;width:50vw;height:50vw;max-width:700px;max-height:700px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(165,157,255,.4),transparent 68%)}
.req-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.9fr);gap:48px 80px;align-items:center}
.request h2{font-size:clamp(40px,6.6vw,96px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-0.018em}
.request .lede{margin-top:24px}
form{background:rgba(11,16,19,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border:1px solid var(--line-g);border-radius:26px;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,36px);display:grid;gap:18px}
label{display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2)}
input,select{min-height:52px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);padding:0 16px;font-size:16px;color:var(--text);width:100%}
input::placeholder{color:var(--text-3)}
select{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='12' height='8' viewBox='0 0 12 8'><path d='M1 1.5l5 5 5-5' fill='none' stroke='%23A9B6B1' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>");background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:right 16px center}
select option{background:#0F171B;color:var(--text)}
input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline-offset:2px;border-color:var(--mint)}
form .btn{width:100%}
.form-msg{min-height:1.4em;font-size:14px;color:var(--mint)}

footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-block:56px 64px;background:var(--night)}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot>div{flex:1 1 360px}
.foot p{color:var(--text-3);font-size:14px;max-width:34rem;margin-top:14px;line-height:1.55}
.foot nav{flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0 4px;align-content:flex-start}
.foot nav a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;color:var(--text-2);text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;border-radius:999px}
.foot nav a:hover{color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}

@media (max-width:980px){
  .links a:not(.btn){display:none}
  .dollar,.scenario,.req-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .review .stick{position:static}
  .svc,.engage{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .team{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .hero-copy{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .roster{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .stat{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:0}
  .stat+.stat{padding-left:0}
  .stat:nth-child(even){padding-left:clamp(14px,3vw,28px);border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .sellers .wrap{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px}
  .marquee{align-self:stretch;width:100%;max-width:100%}
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  .seg{display:flex;width:100%;gap:2px}
  .seg button{flex:1 1 auto;padding:0 6px;font-size:14px}
  .facts dd{font-size:26px}
  .cta-row .btn{width:100%}
  .eyebrow{letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:12px}
  .eyebrow::before{width:24px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  .orb,.track,.gridbg::after,.route ol::after,.route li:last-child i,.scenario::after,.hero h1 .w{animation:none!important}
  .marquee{overflow-x:auto}
  .cells i,.btn{transition:none}
}

  --grad:linear-gradient(100deg,#00FF94 0%,#00FFE0 45%,#A59DFF 100%);color:var(--text)

.hero{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0A1B17 0%,#0E3328 62%,#0F3A2E 100%)}
.sellers{background:#0B2A21}
.problem{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0F3A2E,var(--stage) 50%,#0F3A2E)}
footer{background:var(--stage-deep)}
#request-form{background:rgba(14,51,40,.78)}

/* v8: copy deck applied */
.cta-row .btn-ghost{display:inline-flex}
.sellers .lab a{display:block;color:var(--text-2);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;text-decoration-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.sellers .lab a:hover{color:var(--text);text-decoration-color:var(--mint)}
.seg button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;line-height:1.15;padding-block:6px}
.seg button small{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:400;opacity:.85;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.never small{font-size:.26em;margin-top:.2em;margin-left:.1em}
.source.def{margin-top:10px}
abbr[title]{text-decoration:underline dotted;text-decoration-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);text-underline-offset:6px;cursor:help}
.svc li.vi{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.svc li.vi .btn{margin-top:18px;min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;font-size:15px;position:relative}
.helper{margin:-4px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.45}
.team{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.team li{max-width:34rem}
@media (max-width:620px){.seg button{padding-inline:4px}.seg button small{font-size:11.5px}}
@media (max-width:640px){.hv-l .k{letter-spacing:.05em;font-size:10.5px}}
/* v9: round 2 */
.budget{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:22px;max-width:30rem;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2)}
.budget .in{position:relative;display:block}
.budget .in b{position:absolute;left:16px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-weight:500;color:var(--text-2);font-size:16px}
.budget input{padding-left:32px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;color:var(--text)}
.leader{margin-top:clamp(28px,3.4vw,48px);max-width:48rem;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,32px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);box-shadow:0 18px 40px -28px rgba(8,32,25,.35)}
.lead-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}
.lead-top img{width:88px;height:88px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line),0 10px 24px -12px rgba(8,32,25,.45);flex:0 0 auto}
.lead-top h3{font-size:clamp(21px,2vw,26px);line-height:1.1}
.leader .role{margin-top:4px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#1F7A55}
.leader .bio{margin-top:20px;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text-2)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:20px}
.chips li{padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(11,16,19,.04);font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text)}
.exp{margin-top:clamp(32px,4vw,52px);padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.exp h3{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-3)}
.exp ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 32px;margin-top:14px}
.exp li{font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,20px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#7B8782}
.engage{gap:16px}
.engage article{padding:24px 24px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}
.leader .bio+.bio{margin-top:14px}
.li-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:22px;min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--text);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.li-btn svg{color:#0A66C2}
.li-btn:hover{border-color:#0A66C2;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(10,102,194,.12)}
.foot nav a.li-foot{gap:8px;margin-left:8px;border:1px solid var(--line-g);color:var(--text)}
.foot nav a.li-foot:hover{border-color:var(--mint)}
/* secondary footer links (Q&A pages, privacy) sit under the text, so the main row stays as in the design */
.foot .foot-more{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 20px;margin-top:18px}
.foot .foot-more a{padding:0;min-height:0;border-radius:0;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text-3);text-decoration:none}
.foot .foot-more a:hover{color:var(--text);background:none}
.foot nav a.li-foot svg{color:var(--mint)}
@media (max-width:620px){.lead-top img{width:72px;height:72px}}
.leaders{display:grid;gap:24px;margin-top:clamp(28px,3.4vw,48px)}
@media (min-width:900px){.leaders{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:stretch}}
.leaders .leader{margin-top:0;max-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.leaders .chips{margin-top:18px}
.btnrow{margin-top:auto;padding-top:22px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.btnrow .li-btn{margin-top:0}
.li-btn.site-btn svg{color:var(--text)}
.li-btn.site-btn:hover{border-color:#1F7A55;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(31,122,85,.12)}

/* v9: Supply Path Review, redesigned */
#review .rv-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr);gap:40px clamp(40px,6vw,96px);align-items:center}
#review .rv-copy .eyebrow{margin-bottom:18px}
#review .rv-copy .lede{margin-top:16px;max-width:38rem}
#review .rv-copy h2{margin-top:0}
.rv-stat{margin:0;padding:clamp(24px,2.6vw,34px);border-radius:28px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -36px rgba(8,32,25,.4);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.rv-stat::before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-60px;width:220px;height:220px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,255,148,.28),transparent 68%);pointer-events:none}
.rv-num{position:relative;font-size:clamp(72px,8vw,112px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:.9;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin:0}
.rv-num small{font-size:.42em;letter-spacing:0;margin-left:.06em}
.rv-cap{position:relative;margin-top:14px;font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,20px);line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);max-width:22rem}
.rv-bar{position:relative;margin-top:22px;height:14px;border-radius:99px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(11,16,19,.10) 0 6px,rgba(11,16,19,.04) 6px 12px);overflow:hidden}
.rv-bar i{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:45.1%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00C77D,#00D6C0);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,200,125,.5);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(var(--p,1));transition:transform 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.rv-key{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 18px;margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2)}
.rv-key span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.rv-key em{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px}
.rv-key .k1{background:#00C77D}.rv-key .k2{background:rgba(11,16,19,.16)}
.rv-src{position:relative;margin-top:18px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text-3)}
#review .route{max-width:none;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px);padding:22px clamp(20px,3vw,40px) 24px;border-radius:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border:1px solid var(--line)}
#review .route ol{max-width:760px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:18px}
.step{grid-column:span 3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) 0;border-radius:26px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 22px 44px -32px rgba(8,32,25,.35);overflow:hidden;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .35s,border-color .35s}
.step:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--line-g);box-shadow:0 32px 56px -30px rgba(0,140,88,.5)}
.step-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:22px}
.step .n{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#007A4C;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(0,168,104,.1);border:1px solid rgba(0,140,88,.22)}
.step .art{width:112px;height:auto;flex:none;opacity:.95}
.step h3{font-size:clamp(24px,2.5vw,32px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:22ch}
.step p{margin-top:12px;color:var(--text-2);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;max-width:34rem}
.step>p:not(.get){margin-bottom:26px}
.step .get{margin:auto calc(-1 * clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px)) 0;padding:16px clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) 18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0E3328,#0A261D 70%,#12302F);color:#E9F2EE;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.45;max-width:none;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:baseline}
.step .get span{flex:none;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#00FF94}
.step .get span::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:18px;height:1px;background:#00FF94;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:10px;opacity:.7}
.s5{grid-column:span 6;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.9),rgba(222,244,234,.9))}
.s5-copy{padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) 0 clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px)}
.s5>.get{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0}
.s5 .rank{align-self:center;padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);display:grid;gap:12px}
.rank li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:14px}
.rank b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
.rank i{display:block;height:14px;width:var(--w);border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00C77D,#00D6C0);transform-origin:left}
.rank li:nth-child(3) i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6A5FE0,#9A8FFF)}
.rank li:nth-child(4) i{background:rgba(11,16,19,.2)}
.rank .cap{display:block;grid-template-columns:none;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-3);margin-top:4px}
.rank-in i{animation:rk 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.rank-in li:nth-child(2) i{animation-delay:.12s}.rank-in li:nth-child(3) i{animation-delay:.24s}.rank-in li:nth-child(4) i{animation-delay:.36s}
@keyframes rk{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
@media (max-width:980px){
  #review .rv-head{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .step{grid-column:span 6}
  .s5{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .s5-copy{padding-right:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);padding-bottom:0}
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  .step .art{width:84px}
  .step .get{flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
  .rank li{grid-template-columns:84px minmax(0,1fr)}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.step,.rv-bar i{transition:none}.rank-in i{animation:none}}

          <p class="lede">Your campaign reports show delivery and conversions. They rarely show the supply path: the platforms and resellers between your budget and the page where your ad ran. Across the market, 45.1 cents of every programmatic dollar reaches a qualified impression. The Supply Path Review shows you which side of that number you are on.</p>
          <p class="lede">You give us read-only access to your media reporting, invoices and contracts. We follow the spend, check the placements and test how your results are counted. You get a written report and a working session with our team.</p>

            <h3>What did we buy?</h3>
            <p>Check where ads ran across sites, apps and CTV. Flag made-for-advertising sites, built to sell ad slots, and spoofed CTV, where an impression is sold as a TV screen and never ran on one.</p>

            <div class="step-top"><span class="n">03</span><svg class="art" viewBox="0 0 132 64" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="0" y1="60" x2="132" y2="60" stroke="rgba(11,16,19,.18)" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="30" height="46" rx="5" fill="#00A868"/><rect x="62" y="34" width="30" height="26" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="rgba(11,16,19,.18)" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/><rect x="62" y="34" width="30" height="26" rx="5" fill="rgba(11,16,19,.18)" opacity=".5"/><line x1="44" y1="14" x2="106" y2="14" stroke="#6A5FE0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/><path d="M104 14v20" stroke="#6A5FE0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M99 29l5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#6A5FE0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></div>

            <h3>What did we agree to?</h3>
            <p>Read contracts for who owns your data, how rebates and principal-based buying are handled (principal-based means the agency resells media it bought for itself), and whether you can audit your agency and your platforms.</p>
            <p class="get"><span>You get</span>the clauses that cost you money or access, with the change to ask for.</p>
          </li>

<style>
/* Single committed look, built only from the ViSTARS brand kit v4:
   Night ground #0B1013, night green #0E3328, and the brand gradient #00FF94 > #00FFE0 > #A59DFF.
   Geist for type, Geist Mono for the small labels. The agency runs this palette loud:
   full-bleed glow, the live dollar trace, counting numbers. The tech company runs it quiet. */
:root{
  --night:#0B1013;
  --night-2:#0F171B;
  --night-3:#151D22;
  --stage:#0E3328;
  --stage-deep:#082019;
  --panel:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --line-g:rgba(0,255,148,.28);
  --text:#F3F7F5;
  --text-2:#A9B6B1;
  --text-3:#8B9893;
  --mint:#00FF94;
  --cyan:#00FFE0;
  --peri:#A59DFF;
  --grad:linear-gradient(100deg,#00FF94 0%,#00FFE0 45%,#A59DFF 100%);
  --f-sans:"Source Sans 3",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --f-mono:"Source Sans 3",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --gutter-l:max(clamp(16px,4vw,40px),env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  --gutter-r:max(clamp(16px,4vw,40px),env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  color-scheme:dark;
}
:root{color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--night);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--f-sans);font-size:18px;line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--night);z-index:60}
h1,h2,h3,p,ul,ol,dl,dd{margin:0;padding:0}
ul,ol{list-style:none}
a{color:inherit}
button,input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:var(--gutter-l);top:-80px;background:var(--text);color:var(--night);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:10px;z-index:100;text-decoration:none}
.skip:focus{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 8px)}
.wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--gutter-l);padding-right:var(--gutter-r)}
.mono{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.02em}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.014em;text-wrap:balance}
h2.big{font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,76px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.016em;font-weight:600}
.lede{color:var(--text-2);font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,20px);line-height:1.5;max-width:34rem}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-2)}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:40px;height:2px;background:var(--mint);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--mint)}
.gt{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}

/* shared effects */
.gridbg{position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.gridbg::before,.gridbg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 25%,#000 10%,transparent 78%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 25%,#000 10%,transparent 78%)}
.gridbg::before{background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.055) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:64px 64px}
.gridbg::after{background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 42%,rgba(0,255,148,.16) 50%,transparent 58%);background-size:260% 100%;animation:sweep 10s linear infinite}
@keyframes sweep{from{background-position:130% 0}to{background-position:-130% 0}}
.orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(100px);pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
.spot{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.spot::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s;background:radial-gradient(420px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%),rgba(0,255,148,.16),transparent 62%)}
.spot:hover::before{opacity:1}

/* buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font-weight:500;font-size:16px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:transform .2s,background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .3s}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn-mint{background:var(--mint);color:#04140D;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(0,255,148,.4)}
.btn-mint:hover{background:#3DFFAE;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(0,255,148,.16),0 0 40px rgba(0,255,148,.35)}
.btn-ghost{border-color:var(--line-g);color:var(--text);background:rgba(0,255,148,.05)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--mint);background:rgba(0,255,148,.1)}
.btn svg{width:16px;height:16px}

/* nav */
.nav-shell{position:sticky;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px);z-index:50;height:0}
/* the menu pill's 12px top margin collapsed through this 0-height bar and pushed the page down, leaving a dark strip */
.nav-shell{margin-bottom:-12px}
.nav{padding-left:var(--gutter-l);padding-right:var(--gutter-r)}
.pill{max-width:1240px;margin:12px auto 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:6px 6px 6px 22px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(11,16,19,.66);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.mark{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px}
.mark img{height:26px;width:auto;display:block}
.links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.links a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 15px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;color:var(--text-2);transition:color .2s,background .2s}
.links a:hover{color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.links a.btn{min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;font-size:15px;color:#04140D;background:var(--mint)}
.links a.btn:hover{color:#04140D;background:#3DFFAE}

/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-top:clamp(120px,15vw,172px)}
.hero .orb.o1{width:60vw;height:60vw;max-width:880px;max-height:880px;left:-10%;top:-12%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,255,148,.55),rgba(14,51,40,.9) 55%,transparent 72%);animation:drift 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.hero .orb.o2{width:46vw;height:46vw;max-width:680px;max-height:680px;right:-12%;top:8%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(165,157,255,.42),transparent 68%);animation:drift 30s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse}
.hero .orb.o3{width:50vw;height:30vw;left:25%;top:42%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(0,255,224,.2),transparent 70%)}
@keyframes drift{from{transform:translate3d(-3%,0,0) scale(1)}to{transform:translate3d(5%,5%,0) scale(1.1)}}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(46px,9.4vw,142px);line-height:.94;letter-spacing:-0.02em;font-weight:700;max-width:12.5ch;margin-top:26px}
.hero h1 .w{display:inline-block;animation:rise .95s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i)*75ms + 120ms)}
.hero h1 .a{color:#E8EFEC}
.hero h1 .g1{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#00FF94,#00FFE0);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero h1 .g2{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#00FFE0,#A59DFF);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);filter:blur(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
.hero-copy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:end;gap:32px 56px;margin-top:clamp(28px,4vw,44px)}
.hero-copy .tag{font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px);letter-spacing:-0.008em;line-height:1.2;font-weight:500}
.hero-copy .sub{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:12px;max-width:34rem;font-size:clamp(16px,1.4vw,19px)}
.cta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}

/* hero visual: buckets and tanks, v2 */
.hv{position:relative;margin-top:clamp(44px,6vw,80px);border-radius:32px;padding:clamp(22px,3.4vw,48px);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06),rgba(255,255,255,.012)),radial-gradient(120% 80% at 0% 0%,rgba(0,255,148,.11),transparent 55%),radial-gradient(90% 70% at 100% 100%,rgba(165,157,255,.13),transparent 60%);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);box-shadow:0 60px 140px -50px rgba(0,255,148,.4),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.hv::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;padding:1px;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,255,148,.7),rgba(255,255,255,.04) 32%,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 66%,rgba(165,157,255,.7));
  -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box exclude,linear-gradient(#000 0 0)}
.hv-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px 32px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hv-q{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,64px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.02em;font-weight:650;max-width:19ch;text-wrap:balance}
.hv-four{display:inline-block;font-size:1.32em;line-height:.8;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.024em;padding-right:.04em}
.hv-sample{margin:0}
.tag-s{display:inline-block;border:1px solid rgba(165,157,255,.6);color:var(--peri);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 14px;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.hv-stage{position:relative;margin-top:clamp(20px,3vw,40px);height:clamp(430px,38vw,500px)}
.hv-stage.hv-compact{height:clamp(350px,50vw,430px)}
.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-pill,.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-t,.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-miss,.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-under{display:none}
.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-adv b,.hv-stage.hv-compact .hv-pub b{font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,26px)}
.hv-stage.hv-compact~.hv-legend{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.hv-stage canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.hv-l{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;color:var(--text-2);font-size:13px;line-height:1.3}
.hv-l .k{display:block;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-2);margin-bottom:6px}
.hv-l b{display:block;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-0.016em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hv-adv,.hv-pub{text-align:center;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap}
.hv-adv b{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);color:var(--text)}
.hv-pub b{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);color:var(--mint)}
.hv-under{text-align:center;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-3)}
.hv-under b{display:inline;font-size:18px;color:var(--text);margin-right:6px}
.hv-under.pub b{color:var(--mint)}
.hv-pill{transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;width:min(158px,13.5vw)}
.hv-pill b{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.008em;color:var(--text);line-height:1.15}
.hv-pill i{display:inline-block;margin-top:7px;font-style:normal;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--peri);border:1px solid rgba(165,157,255,.5);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;background:rgba(165,157,255,.07);white-space:nowrap}
.hv-t{transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}
.hv-t b{font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,28px);color:var(--peri)}
.hv-t small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-3);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hv-miss{opacity:0;transition:opacity .8s ease;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.hv-miss.on{opacity:1}
.hv-miss b{font-size:clamp(34px,4.2vw,58px);line-height:.95;color:var(--peri)}
.hv-miss span{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:15px;color:var(--text)}
.hv-miss small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-3)}
.hv-legend{display:none;margin:20px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;gap:12px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--text-2)}
.hv-legend li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.hv-legend i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto}
.hv-legend b{margin-left:auto;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right}
.hv-foot{margin:22px 0 0;max-width:62rem;color:var(--text-3);font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .hv{border-radius:26px}
  .hv-stage.hv-compact{height:360px}
  .hv-stage.hv-compact~.hv-legend{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hv .eyebrow{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;gap:10px}
  .hv .eyebrow::before{width:26px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hv-miss{transition:none}}

/* stats */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0}
.stat{padding:clamp(28px,4vw,52px) clamp(14px,2vw,28px) clamp(28px,4vw,52px) 0;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
.stat+.stat{padding-left:clamp(14px,2vw,28px)}
.stat:last-child{border-right:0}
.stat .n{font-size:clamp(40px,5.1vw,76px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.02em;line-height:.95;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stat p{color:var(--text-2);font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;margin-top:12px;max-width:16rem}
.stat p.n{color:transparent;margin-top:0;max-width:none;font-size:clamp(40px,5.1vw,76px);line-height:.95}

/* sellers */
.sellers{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-block:22px;background:var(--night-2)}
.sellers .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px}
.sellers .lab{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.35}
.sellers .lab b{display:block;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;font-size:15px}
.marquee{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent)}
.track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:scroll 60s linear infinite}
.marquee:hover .track,.marquee:focus-within .track{animation-play-state:paused}
.track ul{display:flex;gap:44px;padding-right:44px}
.track li{white-space:nowrap;font-size:19px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:var(--text-2)}
@keyframes scroll{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

.band{padding-block:clamp(72px,9vw,128px);position:relative}

/* problem */
.problem{overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--night),var(--stage-deep) 60%,var(--night))}
.problem .orb{right:-14%;top:18%;width:60vw;height:60vw;max-width:820px;max-height:820px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,255,148,.34),rgba(14,51,40,.6) 55%,transparent 72%)}
.dollar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.05fr);gap:56px 80px;align-items:center;margin-top:clamp(48px,6vw,88px)}
.never{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(120px,20vw,280px);line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-0.024em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.never small{font-size:.3em;margin-top:.14em;margin-left:.04em;letter-spacing:0;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.never-label{font-size:clamp(18px,1.8vw,22px);color:var(--text-2);margin-top:20px;max-width:24rem}
.seg{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:32px}
.seg button{min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:999px;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;color:var(--text-2);white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.seg button:hover{color:var(--text)}
.seg button[aria-checked="true"]{background:var(--mint);color:#04140D;font-weight:600}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 28px;margin-top:32px;max-width:30rem}
.facts div{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 0 18px}
.facts dt{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-3)}
.facts dd{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-0.016em;font-weight:600;margin-top:2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cells{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);gap:clamp(6px,1.1vw,14px);padding:clamp(18px,2.4vw,32px);border-radius:24px;background:rgba(8,32,25,.55);border:1px solid var(--line-g);box-shadow:0 0 80px -20px rgba(0,255,148,.3) inset}
.cells i{display:block;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);transition:background .5s,box-shadow .5s}
.cells i.on{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#B8FFE0,var(--mint) 55%,var(--cyan));box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,255,148,.6)}
.source{margin-top:48px;color:var(--text-3);font-size:14px;max-width:46rem;line-height:1.55}

/* review */
.route{margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px);max-width:34rem}
.route .cap{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-3)}
.route ol{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);margin-top:22px}
.route ol::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:12.5%;right:12.5%;top:9px;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.route ol::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:12.5%;top:9px;height:2px;width:75%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--mint),var(--cyan));background-size:30% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;animation:pulse 3.2s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.3,1) infinite}
@keyframes pulse{from{background-position:-40% 0}to{background-position:140% 0}}
.route li{position:relative;text-align:center;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.3}
.route li i{display:block;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 12px;background:var(--night);border:2px solid #3A474D;position:relative;z-index:1}
.route li:last-child i{border-color:var(--mint);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(0,255,148,.12),0 0 24px rgba(0,255,148,.6);animation:glowpulse 3.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes glowpulse{0%,60%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,255,148,.08),0 0 10px rgba(0,255,148,.3)}85%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(0,255,148,.16),0 0 30px rgba(0,255,148,.75)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,255,148,.08),0 0 10px rgba(0,255,148,.3)}}
.route li b{display:block;color:var(--text);font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.fee{margin-top:clamp(56px,7vw,96px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px 48px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:clamp(24px,3vw,40px);border-radius:24px;border:1px solid var(--line-g);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(14,51,40,.9),rgba(8,32,25,.7) 60%,rgba(165,157,255,.1))}
.fee p{max-width:44rem;color:var(--text-2);font-size:17px}
.fee p b{color:var(--text);font-weight:500}

/* services */
.svc-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:24px 64px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.svc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,72px)}
.svc li{padding:28px 26px 34px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;background:var(--panel);transition:border-color .3s}
.svc li:hover{border-color:var(--line-g)}
.svc h3{font-size:clamp(21px,2vw,26px);line-height:1.12;position:relative}
.svc p{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:12px;font-size:16px;max-width:24rem;position:relative}

/* work */
.work{background:var(--night-2)}
.scenario{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,72px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:32px 64px;align-items:center;padding:clamp(28px,4.5vw,64px);border-radius:30px;border:1px solid var(--line-g);background:var(--stage)}
.scenario::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:48px 48px;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 50%,#000,transparent 75%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 50%,#000,transparent 75%)}
.scenario::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-12%;top:-40%;width:70%;height:180%;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(circle at 60% 50%,rgba(0,255,148,.45),rgba(0,255,224,.15) 45%,transparent 68%);filter:blur(30px);animation:drift 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.pilltag{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--line-g);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2);background:rgba(8,32,25,.7)}
.scenario h3{font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,44px);line-height:1.05;margin-top:22px;font-weight:600}
.scenario p.d{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:16px;max-width:30rem}
.scenario .num{font-size:clamp(60px,8.2vw,124px);white-space:nowrap;font-weight:700;line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-0.024em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.scenario .cap{color:var(--text);opacity:.86;margin-top:14px;max-width:24rem;font-size:16px}
.engage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 40px;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px)}
.engage article{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 0 12px}
.engage .tg{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--mint)}
.engage h3{font-size:clamp(24px,2.4vw,30px);margin-top:10px}
.engage p{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:8px;font-size:16px}
.engage ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 16px;margin-top:16px;color:var(--text-3);font-size:14px}
.roster{margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,72px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px 56px}
.roster h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--text-3);margin-bottom:12px}
.roster ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 26px}
.roster li{font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);letter-spacing:-0.012em;font-weight:500;color:var(--text)}

/* team */
.team{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 36px;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,72px)}
.team li{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:22px 0 34px}
.team h3{font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,25px);line-height:1.1}
.team p{color:var(--text-2);margin-top:6px;font-size:15px}

/* request */
.request{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;padding-block:clamp(88px,12vw,160px);background:var(--stage-deep)}
.request .orb{left:-12%;bottom:-45%;width:90vw;height:90vw;max-width:1100px;max-height:1100px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,255,148,.5),rgba(14,51,40,.8) 50%,transparent 72%)}
.request .orb.b{left:auto;right:-14%;top:-30%;bottom:auto;width:50vw;height:50vw;max-width:700px;max-height:700px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(165,157,255,.4),transparent 68%)}
.req-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.9fr);gap:48px 80px;align-items:center}
.request h2{font-size:clamp(40px,6.6vw,96px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-0.018em}
.request .lede{margin-top:24px}
form{background:rgba(11,16,19,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border:1px solid var(--line-g);border-radius:26px;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,36px);display:grid;gap:18px}
label{display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2)}
input,select{min-height:52px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);padding:0 16px;font-size:16px;color:var(--text);width:100%}
input::placeholder{color:var(--text-3)}
select{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='12' height='8' viewBox='0 0 12 8'><path d='M1 1.5l5 5 5-5' fill='none' stroke='%23A9B6B1' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>");background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:right 16px center}
select option{background:#0F171B;color:var(--text)}
input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline-offset:2px;border-color:var(--mint)}
form .btn{width:100%}
.form-msg{min-height:1.4em;font-size:14px;color:var(--mint)}

footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-block:56px 64px;background:var(--night)}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot>div{flex:1 1 360px}
.foot p{color:var(--text-3);font-size:14px;max-width:34rem;margin-top:14px;line-height:1.55}
.foot nav{flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0 4px;align-content:flex-start}
.foot nav a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;color:var(--text-2);text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;border-radius:999px}
.foot nav a:hover{color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}

@media (max-width:980px){
  .links a:not(.btn){display:none}
  .dollar,.scenario,.req-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .review .stick{position:static}
  .svc,.engage{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .team{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .hero-copy{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .roster{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .stat{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:0}
  .stat+.stat{padding-left:0}
  .stat:nth-child(even){padding-left:clamp(14px,3vw,28px);border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .sellers .wrap{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px}
  .marquee{align-self:stretch;width:100%;max-width:100%}
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  .seg{display:flex;width:100%;gap:2px}
  .seg button{flex:1 1 auto;padding:0 6px;font-size:14px}
  .facts dd{font-size:26px}
  .cta-row .btn{width:100%}
  .eyebrow{letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:12px}
  .eyebrow::before{width:24px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  .orb,.track,.gridbg::after,.route ol::after,.route li:last-child i,.scenario::after,.hero h1 .w{animation:none!important}
  .marquee{overflow-x:auto}
  .cells i,.btn{transition:none}
}

  --grad:linear-gradient(100deg,#00FF94 0%,#00FFE0 45%,#A59DFF 100%);color:var(--text)

.hero{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0A1B17 0%,#0E3328 62%,#0F3A2E 100%)}
.sellers{background:#0B2A21}
.problem{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0F3A2E,var(--stage) 50%,#0F3A2E)}
footer{background:var(--stage-deep)}
#request-form{background:rgba(14,51,40,.78)}

/* v8: copy deck applied */
.cta-row .btn-ghost{display:inline-flex}
.sellers .lab a{display:block;color:var(--text-2);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;text-decoration-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.sellers .lab a:hover{color:var(--text);text-decoration-color:var(--mint)}
.seg button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;line-height:1.15;padding-block:6px}
.seg button small{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:400;opacity:.85;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.never small{font-size:.26em;margin-top:.2em;margin-left:.1em}
.source.def{margin-top:10px}
abbr[title]{text-decoration:underline dotted;text-decoration-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);text-underline-offset:6px;cursor:help}
.svc li.vi{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.svc li.vi .btn{margin-top:18px;min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;font-size:15px;position:relative}
.helper{margin:-4px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.45}
.team{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.team li{max-width:34rem}
@media (max-width:620px){.seg button{padding-inline:4px}.seg button small{font-size:11.5px}}
@media (max-width:640px){.hv-l .k{letter-spacing:.05em;font-size:10.5px}}
/* v9: round 2 */
.budget{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:22px;max-width:30rem;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2)}
.budget .in{position:relative;display:block}
.budget .in b{position:absolute;left:16px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-weight:500;color:var(--text-2);font-size:16px}
.budget input{padding-left:32px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;color:var(--text)}
.leader{margin-top:clamp(28px,3.4vw,48px);max-width:48rem;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,32px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);box-shadow:0 18px 40px -28px rgba(8,32,25,.35)}
.lead-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}
.lead-top img{width:88px;height:88px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line),0 10px 24px -12px rgba(8,32,25,.45);flex:0 0 auto}
.lead-top h3{font-size:clamp(21px,2vw,26px);line-height:1.1}
.leader .role{margin-top:4px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#1F7A55}
.leader .bio{margin-top:20px;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text-2)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:20px}
.chips li{padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(11,16,19,.04);font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text)}
.exp{margin-top:clamp(32px,4vw,52px);padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.exp h3{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-3)}
.exp ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 32px;margin-top:14px}
.exp li{font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,20px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#7B8782}
.engage{gap:16px}
.engage article{padding:24px 24px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}
.leader .bio+.bio{margin-top:14px}
.li-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:22px;min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--text);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.li-btn svg{color:#0A66C2}
.li-btn:hover{border-color:#0A66C2;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(10,102,194,.12)}
.foot nav a.li-foot{gap:8px;margin-left:8px;border:1px solid var(--line-g);color:var(--text)}
.foot nav a.li-foot:hover{border-color:var(--mint)}
/* secondary footer links (Q&A pages, privacy) sit under the text, so the main row stays as in the design */
.foot .foot-more{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 20px;margin-top:18px}
.foot .foot-more a{padding:0;min-height:0;border-radius:0;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text-3);text-decoration:none}
.foot .foot-more a:hover{color:var(--text);background:none}
.foot nav a.li-foot svg{color:var(--mint)}
@media (max-width:620px){.lead-top img{width:72px;height:72px}}
.leaders{display:grid;gap:24px;margin-top:clamp(28px,3.4vw,48px)}
@media (min-width:900px){.leaders{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:stretch}}
.leaders .leader{margin-top:0;max-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.leaders .chips{margin-top:18px}
.btnrow{margin-top:auto;padding-top:22px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.btnrow .li-btn{margin-top:0}
.li-btn.site-btn svg{color:var(--text)}
.li-btn.site-btn:hover{border-color:#1F7A55;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(31,122,85,.12)}

/* v9: Supply Path Review, redesigned */
#review .rv-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr);gap:40px clamp(40px,6vw,96px);align-items:center}
#review .rv-copy .eyebrow{margin-bottom:18px}
#review .rv-copy .lede{margin-top:16px;max-width:38rem}
#review .rv-copy h2{margin-top:0}
.rv-stat{margin:0;padding:clamp(24px,2.6vw,34px);border-radius:28px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -36px rgba(8,32,25,.4);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.rv-stat::before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-60px;width:220px;height:220px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,255,148,.28),transparent 68%);pointer-events:none}
.rv-num{position:relative;font-size:clamp(72px,8vw,112px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:.9;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin:0}
.rv-num small{font-size:.42em;letter-spacing:0;margin-left:.06em}
.rv-cap{position:relative;margin-top:14px;font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,20px);line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);max-width:22rem}
.rv-bar{position:relative;margin-top:22px;height:14px;border-radius:99px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(11,16,19,.10) 0 6px,rgba(11,16,19,.04) 6px 12px);overflow:hidden}
.rv-bar i{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:45.1%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00C77D,#00D6C0);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,200,125,.5);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(var(--p,1));transition:transform 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.rv-key{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 18px;margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2)}
.rv-key span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.rv-key em{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px}
.rv-key .k1{background:#00C77D}.rv-key .k2{background:rgba(11,16,19,.16)}
.rv-src{position:relative;margin-top:18px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text-3)}
#review .route{max-width:none;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px);padding:22px clamp(20px,3vw,40px) 24px;border-radius:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border:1px solid var(--line)}
#review .route ol{max-width:760px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:18px}
.step{grid-column:span 3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) 0;border-radius:26px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 22px 44px -32px rgba(8,32,25,.35);overflow:hidden;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .35s,border-color .35s}
.step:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--line-g);box-shadow:0 32px 56px -30px rgba(0,140,88,.5)}
.step-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:22px}
.step .n{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#007A4C;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(0,168,104,.1);border:1px solid rgba(0,140,88,.22)}
.step .art{width:112px;height:auto;flex:none;opacity:.95}
.step h3{font-size:clamp(24px,2.5vw,32px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:22ch}
.step p{margin-top:12px;color:var(--text-2);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;max-width:34rem}
.step>p:not(.get){margin-bottom:26px}
.step .get{margin:auto calc(-1 * clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px)) 0;padding:16px clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) 18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0E3328,#0A261D 70%,#12302F);color:#E9F2EE;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.45;max-width:none;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:baseline}
.step .get span{flex:none;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#00FF94}
.step .get span::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:18px;height:1px;background:#00FF94;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:10px;opacity:.7}
.s5{grid-column:span 6;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.9),rgba(222,244,234,.9))}
.s5-copy{padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) 0 clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px) clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px)}
.s5>.get{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0}
.s5 .rank{align-self:center;padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);display:grid;gap:12px}
.rank li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:14px}
.rank b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
.rank i{display:block;height:14px;width:var(--w);border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00C77D,#00D6C0);transform-origin:left}
.rank li:nth-child(3) i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6A5FE0,#9A8FFF)}
.rank li:nth-child(4) i{background:rgba(11,16,19,.2)}
.rank .cap{display:block;grid-template-columns:none;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-3);margin-top:4px}
.rank-in i{animation:rk 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.rank-in li:nth-child(2) i{animation-delay:.12s}.rank-in li:nth-child(3) i{animation-delay:.24s}.rank-in li:nth-child(4) i{animation-delay:.36s}
@keyframes rk{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
@media (max-width:980px){
  #review .rv-head{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .step{grid-column:span 6}
  .s5{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .s5-copy{padding-right:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);padding-bottom:0}
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  .step .art{width:84px}
  .step .get{flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
  .rank li{grid-template-columns:84px minmax(0,1fr)}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.step,.rv-bar i{transition:none}.rank-in i{animation:none}}

          <p class="lede">Your campaign reports show delivery and conversions. They rarely show the supply path: the platforms and resellers between your budget and the page where your ad ran. Across the market, 45.1 cents of every programmatic dollar reaches a qualified impression. The Supply Path Review shows you which side of that number you are on.</p>
          <p class="lede">You give us read-only access to your media reporting, invoices and contracts. We follow the spend, check the placements and test how your results are counted. You get a written report and a working session with our team.</p>

            <h3>What did we buy?</h3>
            <p>Check where ads ran across sites, apps and CTV. Flag made-for-advertising sites, built to sell ad slots, and spoofed CTV, where an impression is sold as a TV screen and never ran on one.</p>

            <div class="step-top"><span class="n">03</span><svg class="art" viewBox="0 0 132 64" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="0" y1="60" x2="132" y2="60" stroke="rgba(11,16,19,.18)" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="30" height="46" rx="5" fill="#00A868"/><rect x="62" y="34" width="30" height="26" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="rgba(11,16,19,.18)" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/><rect x="62" y="34" width="30" height="26" rx="5" fill="rgba(11,16,19,.18)" opacity=".5"/><line x1="44" y1="14" x2="106" y2="14" stroke="#6A5FE0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/><path d="M104 14v20" stroke="#6A5FE0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M99 29l5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#6A5FE0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></div>

            <h3>What did we agree to?</h3>
            <p>Read contracts for who owns your data, how rebates and principal-based buying are handled (principal-based means the agency resells media it bought for itself), and whether you can audit your agency and your platforms.</p>
            <p class="get"><span>You get</span>the clauses that cost you money or access, with the change to ask for.</p>
          </li>
